deck_title: Enterprise E-Commerce Performance Ad A/B Testing & 3-Second CTR Hook Generator Workbench: Modular 3s AI Hook Matrix (Seedance 1.0 Pro / Kling 2.1 / Veo 3) × 9s Cached SKU Body × 3s Remotion CTA (c_hook = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive 15s Full-Clip Regeneration

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise E-Commerce Performance Ad A/B Testing evaluation (decomposing 15-second TikTok/Meta/Douyin performance ads into 5× 3-second AI visual hooks [Seedance 1.0 Pro / Kling 2.1 / Veo 3], 2× 9-second studio-verified SKU demo bodies, and 3× 3-second Remotion dynamic CTA endcards to synthesize 30 orthogonal A/B ad variants from 33s of source footage instead of 450s, gated by a VLM pre-flight Thumbstop predictor so amortized per-variant cost c_hook(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_hook = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive end-to-end 15s full-clip regeneration per variant (which wastes 13.6x GPU seconds and mutates middle product shots, inflating creative cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-combination creative matrix quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: High-velocity TikTok, Meta Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Douyin performance marketing campaigns requiring 20–100 A/B creative variants per SKU
Generating only the first 3 seconds (Hook) across Seedance 1.0 Pro, Kling 2.1, and Veo 3 while reusing a studio-locked 9s product body and 3s Remotion CTA
Decoupled 6-hour attribution: swapping only the 3s Hook when Thumbstop Rate is low, or swapping only the 3s CTA when checkout CVR is low
not_for: Regenerating the entire 15-second video end-to-end with a flagship diffusion API just to test a new 3-second opening hook or promo code
Allowing unconstrained video diffusion to hallucinate middle-segment product demonstrations
Single-shot brand films with zero A/B performance testing requirements

dark_box.lead: MIT original code. Synthetic educational scene; local checks reproduced. No production, physics, or neural inference certification.
